description: Cadence BioSystems was created to tackle a practical problem in deep-space missions: how a crew manages medical issues when Houston is up to 20 minutes away by radio. Instead of relying on live ground support, we are building CADENCE, an onboard health console designed to help astronauts without medical degrees track physiological trends, spot early warning signs across NASA's five spaceflight hazards, and walk through guided ultrasound and countermeasure checks independently.
